question: Find the HCF of the numbers 4220, 5440 and 6880.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Divide all numbers by common factor step-by-step

4220, 5440, 6880 are all divisible by 20

⇒ 211, 272, 344

Now HCF of 211, 272, 344 = 1

So HCF = 20

**∴ Answer = 20**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers = 4220, 5440, 6880

**Formula used:**

HCF by prime factorization method

**Calculation:**

⇒ 4220 = 2 × 2 × 5 × 211

⇒ 5440 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 5 × 17

⇒ 6880 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 5 × 43

⇒ Common factors = 2 × 2 × 5

⇒ HCF = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF Concept

HCF is the greatest number that divides all given numbers exactly.

Prime Factorization

Break numbers into prime factors and multiply common primes.

Division Method

Repeated division by common numbers helps quickly find HCF.
